name: qa-touchstone
description: A desktop API client and embedded QA utility for local test workflows.

scripts.icons: node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/source.png && node scripts/gen-favicon.mjs
scripts.test:html-view: (npm run test:html || true) && node scripts/generate-test-index.js && npx vite preview --outDir src/__tests__/test-report --open
scripts.test:coverage-view: (npm run test:coverage || true) && npx vite preview --outDir src/__tests__/test-report/coverage --open
scripts.electron-dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail --success first "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron . --disable-gpu --enable-software-rasterizer --no-sandbox"
scripts.dist: npm run test && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run test:ci && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: npm run test:ci && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm run test:ci && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm run test:ci && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:unsigned-force: npm run test:ci && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac && codesign --remove-signature release-executables/mac/*.app

author: unuwayne

extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: This app needs access to documents folder for managing configuration files and exports.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: This app needs access to downloads folder for importing files and managing downloaded resources.
